claude-usage.heading: Usage tracking
claude-usage.description: Connect a Claude account to fetch usage limits.
claude-usage.loading: Checking whether this server supports usage tracking...
claude-usage.unavailable: This server does not support Claude usage tracking. Update the server to enable it. Nothing was sent.
claude-usage.statusUnknown: Could not check whether this server supports usage tracking, so connecting is unavailable.
claude-usage.preparing: Starting the Claude sign-in on the server...
claude-usage.waiting: Sign in with the Claude account you want to track, then paste the approval code Claude shows.
claude-usage.browserFailed: The browser could not be opened. Try Open browser again.
claude-usage.codeHint: The code is sent once and is never shown again.
claude-usage.codeSubmitted: Code sent. Waiting for Claude to confirm the sign-in...
claude-usage.canceling: Canceling. The server is stopping the original sign-in.
claude-usage.confirmBody: Usage will be shown for this signed-in account. Confirm it is the account you want to track.
claude-usage.disconnectBody: Usage limits stop updating and this usage sign-in is removed. Your execution sign-in is unchanged.
claude-usage.status.waitingFirst: Waiting for the first usage reading.
claude-usage.status.stale: Usage values are out of date. The next reading refreshes them.
claude-usage.status.backoff: The provider asked to pause usage reads. Refresh is available again after {{v0}}.
claude-usage.status.failed: The last reading failed. The previous values are shown and their time is unchanged.
claude-usage.status.reconnect: This usage sign-in expired or was rejected. Reconnect the usage account. Execution is not affected.
claude-usage.status.cleanup: Removing the previous usage sign-in. Reads are paused until it finishes.
claude-usage.state.canceled: The usage sign-in was canceled. Nothing was linked.
claude-usage.state.expired: The usage sign-in expired. Nothing was linked.
claude-usage.state.failed: The usage sign-in failed. Nothing was linked.
claude-usage.state.unsupported: This server cannot complete a usage sign-in. Nothing was linked.
claude-usage.state.recovery: The server is cleaning up the usage sign-in. Try again after it finishes.
claude-usage.codeUnconfirmed: The result of the last approval-code submission is unknown. Check the sign-in progress, then enter the code again if it is still requested.
claude-usage.requestUnconfirmed: The result of the last request is unknown. Retry the original request; no new request is sent.
claude-usage.failure.timeout: The usage service did not answer in time.
claude-usage.failure.network: The usage service could not be reached.
claude-usage.failure.routeUnsupported: The selected server network route cannot reach the usage service.
claude-usage.failure.redirect: The usage service answered with an unexpected redirect.
claude-usage.failure.oversized: The usage response was larger than allowed.
claude-usage.failure.malformed: The usage response was not valid.
claude-usage.failure.empty: The usage response contained no limits.
claude-usage.failure.unauthorized: The usage service rejected the sign-in.
claude-usage.failure.forbidden: The usage service refused the request.
claude-usage.failure.rateLimited: The usage service is rate limiting reads.
claude-usage.failure.serverError: The usage service reported an error.
claude-usage.failure.storageUnsupported: This server's credential storage is not supported for usage tracking.
claude-usage.failure.refreshRejected: The usage sign-in could not be renewed.
claude-usage.failure.refreshUnsupported: This Claude Code version cannot renew the usage sign-in.
claude-usage.failure.refreshUncertain: Renewing the usage sign-in did not finish cleanly.
claude-usage.failure.identityChanged: The renewed sign-in belongs to a different account.
claude-usage.failure.loginRejected: The usage sign-in was not accepted.
claude-usage.failure.loginUnsupported: This server cannot run the usage sign-in.
claude-usage.failure.loginManualCode: The sign-in did not offer the manual approval-code method, which remote servers require.
claude-usage.failure.profileUnsafe: The server's usage profile was not empty or safe to use.
claude-usage.failure.cleanupUncertain: Cleanup of the usage sign-in is not confirmed yet.
claude-usage.failure.installation: The Claude Code installation on the server is not supported.
claude-usage.failure.authorityChanged: The usage connection changed during the reading.
